figures.caption: Predicted peptide 3-D structures of NACAP-II together with respective Ramachandran validation plots. (A) NACAP-II modeled using I-TASSER in stick format. (B) NACAP-II Ramachandran plot modeled using I-TASSER. (C) NACAP-II modeled using PEP-FOLD. (D) NACAP-II Ramachandran plot modeled using PEP-FOLD. Red regions (A, B and L) represent locations of residues in most favored region; Yellow regions (a, b, and l) represent locations of residues in additional allowed regions; Citrine regions (~a, ~b, ~l and ~p) represents locations of residues in generously allowed regions; White regions represents locations of residues in disallowed regions. Most of the amino acid residues in the PEP-FOLD-modeled NACAP-II peptide were in the most favored region (84.6%), with no residue in the disallowed region.
